display.purpose: The home h1: Saira 800 italic uppercase at width 118, two lines, key words in Hot Pink with a glow.

headline.purpose: Section heads and Operate page titles from 640px; storefront page titles below 640px.

readout.purpose: The configurator total: white tabular numerals with a pink halo, rolling to each new price.

headline-sm.purpose: Operate page titles below 640px, sign-in card titles, stage numerals.

section-sm.purpose: Section heads below 640px, admin detail titles, the house-rules title from 640px, the rank-board total.

stat.purpose: Stat tile values, stepper values and admin counts, tabular.

headline-xs.purpose: A seller's storefront name below 640px (2.6rem above).

title-lg.purpose: Empty-state titles, readout headings, counter headings.

title.purpose: Card titles on order, checkout and settings pages; the admin bar title; the coin-bar total.

card-label-lg.purpose: Slash labels on seller storefront sections.

wordmark.purpose: The solid white wordmark from 640px and in the footer; 1.75rem from 1024px (width 114).

wordmark-sm.purpose: The header wordmark below 640px; hidden below 350px.

card-label.purpose: The slash label that names a card: / YOUR RANK, / GOAL, / EXTRAS.

button.purpose: Saira 700 upright caps on every button (0.8125rem small, 1rem large); the coin plate goes 800 italic.

legend.purpose: Saira caps for total legends and score-table keys.

label.purpose: Saira caps for chips, table heads, rail and footer group titles, readout legends.

label-sm.purpose: The floor: P1 / GOAL tags, badge counts, the coin-bar legend, admin group titles.

title-sans.purpose: Rubik 600 h3s in stage cards and long-form copy.

body.purpose: All reading text in Mist, 56 to 78ch, line-height 1.625 (1.7 in long-form).

body-ui.purpose: Nav links, the trust row, field values and listing titles.

body-sm.purpose: Menus, rail rows, table cells, secondary copy.

small.purpose: Hints, captions, breadcrumbs, meta, score lines.

caption.purpose: Notes, mode descriptions, the legal line.

shadows.name: card-drop
shadows.purpose: Panels and menus, over a 2.5% white top sheen. Flat cards take none.

shadows.name: feature-card
shadows.purpose: Feature cards (.crt), with a pink hairline at 22% and a 10% pink corner wash.

shadows.name: total-bar
shadows.purpose: The total bar and the coin bar: a lit pink lower edge.

shadows.name: coin-plate
shadows.purpose: The Insert coin plate at rest.

shadows.name: coin-plate-hover
shadows.purpose: The Insert coin plate on hover.

shadows.name: filled-button
shadows.purpose: Filled pink buttons; hover goes to 0 0 28px -4px at 80% with the ring at 80%.

shadows.name: selected-button
shadows.purpose: The selected outline button, over a 16% pink wash and a pink border at 75%.

shadows.name: cursor-frame-active
shadows.purpose: A chosen tile, mode, package or thumbnail, over a 7% pink wash.

shadows.name: cursor-frame-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover and focus on a selectable tile.

shadows.name: tag-glow
shadows.purpose: The P1 / GOAL tag.

shadows.name: segment-active
shadows.purpose: The chosen segment.

shadows.name: icon-tile
shadows.purpose: House-rule icon tiles.

shadows.name: slash-bar
shadows.purpose: The slanted bar of a slash label.

shadows.name: streak
shadows.purpose: Light streaks on the home hero and the default storefront banner.

shadows.name: icon-glow
shadows.purpose: Trust-row icons; the B mark uses 14px at 35%, the coin stack 10px at 55%.

shadows.name: headline-glow
shadows.purpose: The home h1; its Hot Pink words take 0 0 28px at 45%.

shadows.name: total-glow
shadows.purpose: White total and readout numerals.

shadows.name: header-plate-edge
shadows.purpose: The 2px lit edge (Streak Core into Hot Pink) of the slanted -28° plate behind the header logo.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every focusable element.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Focused fields, with the border at Hot Pink 70% instead of the outline.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing: button press and glow, the price flash.

motion.name: button-press
motion.value: transform 120ms ease-out-expo; translateY(1px) (the coin plate keeps its -10deg skew)

motion.name: button-glow
motion.value: box-shadow 180ms ease-out-expo; background, border, color 160ms ease

motion.name: cursor-frame
motion.purpose: Selection frame on hover and choice.

motion.name: nav-slash
motion.value: 150ms; slide 4px in from the left and fade in

motion.name: line-flash
motion.purpose: A price line that just changed lights up, then settles.

motion.name: total-roll
motion.purpose: Totals roll to the new price.

motion.name: lift
motion.value: 200ms; game tiles -4px, emblems and the B mark -2px; covers scale 1.03 to 1.04 over 300ms
motion.purpose: Hover on tiles, cards and the logo.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 0.001ms; one iteration; totals jump

components.name: Insert Coin Plate
components.description: The one main action of a screen: a slanted deep-pink plate with the coin-slot icon and a chevron.
components.css: .ds-coin-stage { display: inline-block; padding: 24px 32px; background: var(--color-cab, #0b0b16); border-radius: 14px; } .ds-coin { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 250px; height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; position: relative; isolation: isolate; background: transparent; color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-display, Saira, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 800; font-style: italic; font-stretch: 105%; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-coin::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; transform: skewX(-10deg); background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-p2, #e3126f) 0%, #d40e69 55%, #c00b5e 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22), 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 46 136 / 0.55), 0 0 28px -4px rgb(255 46 136 / 0.7), 0 12px 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9); transition: box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-coin-ico { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-coin-chev { margin-left: auto; } .ds-coin:hover::before { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.28), 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 46 136 / 0.8), 0 0 40px 0 rgb(255 46 136 / 0.75), 0 12px 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9); } .ds-coin:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-coin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-p1, #ff2e88); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filled Button
components.description: Secondary and repeated pink actions (Create account, Buy now, Follow): a deep-pink face under white caps.

components.name: Ghost Button

components.name: Selected Button

components.name: Field

narrative.overview:
Boosterinio is a ranked ladder lit in hot pink at night. The page is near-black with an indigo cast, diagonal pink light streaks and a large brushed-metal B plate behind the hero; type is white, heavy, italic, uppercase and wide; one accent, hot pink, marks everything you can act on or have chosen. The climb is picked on a dark rank board (your rank and your goal, as the publisher's own emblems) and paid with one slanted pink plate. The world was pinned by the owner's reference image on 2 Nov 2026 and replaces the arcade "Attract Mode" world. Class names from that world survive for stability and now describe new things: `crt` is the dark feature card, `phosphor` is soft pink text, `marquee` is the header, `coin` is the main action, `font-pixel` is the small Saira label.

Pink ranks the screen. The ground stays dark and the cards stay quiet (cool grey ink, hairline borders, long soft black drops), so pink light carries the hierarchy: the Insert coin plate is the brightest object in view, then the chosen tile with its tag, then pink icons, highlighted words and the streaks. Type has two voices: Saira, at width 118 and 800 italic, says what the storefront shouts (titles, numbers, buttons, labels); Rubik carries every sentence a person has to read, including all trust copy.

The full world (streaks, the metal B plate, feature cards, the total bar) belongs to the storefront: home, game hubs, the boosting configurator, the marketplace and seller storefronts, checkout, order pages and the sign-in cards. Dashboards, seller tools, the booster board and admin are Operate surfaces: they keep the type, palette, cards, chips, the rail slash and the coin plate for their one main action, but never the streaks or the metal B plate.
keyCharacteristics: One accent: hot pink. #ff2e88 glows, outlines and colors pink text; #e3126f fills anything that carries white text.
Near-black indigo ground (#0b0b16) with a pink radial glow at the top of the page and diagonal light streaks on the home hero.
White heavy italic uppercase display type in Saira at width 118; Rubik for reading.
Dark hairline cards with long soft drops; pink-edged feature cards for the rank board, readouts and totals.
One slanted pink Insert coin plate per screen.
Selection as a pink frame with a glow and, on rank tiles, a P1 or GOAL tag.
The pink italic B (speed flag, cut, chamfers) beside a solid white wordmark; the B returns as the brushed-metal plate behind the hero and as faint flat plates.

rules.name: The One Pink Rule
rules.body: Hot pink is the only accent. Actions, selection, tags, icons, highlighted words and light are pink; green, amber and red appear only when they report a state. No second hue for chrome and nothing orange near the brand. Publisher art (game covers, rank emblems) keeps its own colors because it is content.

rules.name: The White-On-Deep Rule
rules.body: p1 (#ff2e88) is for glows, outlines, icons and pink text on dark. Any filled surface that carries white text uses p2 (#e3126f) or a deeper stop, because white on p1 is only 3.5:1 and white on p2 is 4.6:1. The class `.btn-p1` is filled with p2, and the P1 tag is a p2 pill.

rules.name: The Wide Italic Rule
rules.body: Saira is the storefront's voice: titles, numbers, buttons and labels. Anything read as a sentence, any form value and any table cell is Rubik. No label goes below 0.625rem.

rules.name: The Slash Label Rule
rules.body: A card names itself with a slash label: Saira 800 italic, 1.0625rem, with a slanted pink bar in front (0.24em by 0.95em, skewed -18°, Highlight Pink into Hot Pink, glowing 10px at 55%). It reads "/ YOUR RANK", "/ GOAL", "/ SERVER & QUEUE". The slash label is the card's heading; it never sits above another heading.

rules.name: The Pink Light Rule
rules.body: Glow is pink, and it comes from what you can act on or have chosen: the coin plate, filled buttons, the chosen tile and its tag, icons, streaks and highlighted words. Plain cards, headings and borders do not glow.

rules.name: The Soft Drop Rule
rules.body: Every drop is blurred and negatively spread. No card, button or tile takes a hard offset shadow.

rules.name: The Radius Tracks Size Rule
rules.body: 2px for the slash bar and streak ends, 6px badges and score lines, 7px count chips and photo badges, 8px segments and division pills, 9px small controls and menu rows, 10px buttons, fields, rail rows and avatars, 11px the segmented track, 12px tiles and large buttons, 14px cards and game tiles, 16px panels and galleries, 18px feature cards and the total bar, 24px the storefront avatar, 999px chips and tags.

rules.name: The Upright Grid Rule
rules.body: Cards, fields, pills, tiles and tags stay square to the grid; the coin plate is the only control that leans.

rules.name: The One Coin Rule
rules.body: The slanted `.btn-coin` plate is reserved for the one main action of a screen: Insert coin, Pay, Confirm and release payment, Mark boost finished, Save on a settings or admin form, Create account on the register card. Repeated and secondary actions take the filled, selected or ghost button. Below 1024px the configurator's coin bar scrolls away with the controls before the readout's plate arrives, so one coin is in view.

rules.name: The Cursor Frame Rule
rules.body: Selection is the cursor frame: a 1.5px Hot Pink ring, a soft pink glow and a 7% pink wash, with a 1px ring at 45% on hover. A chosen rank tile also carries its tag: P1 for your rank, GOAL for the target. Play modes, packages, gallery thumbnails and game tiles use the same frame without a tag.

rules.name: The Truthful Label Rule
rules.body: Trust labels, counts and reviews say only what is true today: Secure Escrow, Verified Boosters, Transparent Pricing, Human Support. Support is staffed during set hours, so never "24/7". No invented stats, ratings, review counts or testimonials: review sections render real reviews or nothing, and counters show real counts, including zero.

rules.name: The Publisher Art Rule
rules.body: Game covers and rank emblems are the publishers' own artwork, used only to identify the game or rank, and every shipped raster is listed with its source in `docs/image-sources.md`. A new raster ships with its line there. Brand assets (the B, the wordmark, the favicon, the social image) are drawn in code.

dos: Do keep hot pink the only accent: #ff2e88 for glows, outlines, icons and pink text on dark; #e3126f under any white text.
Do give each screen one slanted Insert coin plate (#e3126f to #c00b5e at -10°, white 800 italic caps) and keep it the brightest object in view.
Do name cards with a slash label (Saira 800 italic, 1.0625rem, slanted pink bar).
Do mark a choice with the cursor frame, and put a P1 or GOAL tag (#e3126f pill, white 0.625rem caps) on a chosen rank tile.
Do set prices and totals as Saira display numerals with tabular figures, in white with a faint pink halo, under a Soft Pink caps legend.
Do use feature cards (#17162a to #10101e, pink hairline at 22%, 18px) for the rank board, readouts, receipts and score tables, and plain cards (#121222, #28273f hairline) for everything else.
Do use 16 to 20px stroke icons, Hot Pink when they carry meaning and Dusk when inactive.
Do keep reading copy in Rubik, in Mist, at 56 to 78ch.
Do list every shipped game cover and rank emblem with its publisher source in `docs/image-sources.md`.
Do still every animation and transition under reduced motion; totals jump instead of rolling.
donts: Don't put white text on a #ff2e88 fill; it is 3.5:1. Fill with #e3126f or deeper.
Don't light two coin plates in one view, and don't slant any other control.
Don't add a second accent hue or lead with orange; amber only reports a state.
Don't claim "24/7", invent stats, ratings or testimonials, or show a review section without real reviews.

Don't stack a small label or pill above a heading to introduce it; pills name a state, a tag or a choice. The one exception is the "LoL Boosting" pill above the home headline, which the owner's reference image pins.
Don't give a card, button or tile a hard offset shadow.
Don't set sentences, form values or table cells in Saira, or any label below 0.625rem.
Don't bring the streaks or the metal B plate into dashboards, seller tools, the booster board or admin.
